errors.text_span: This pie chart presents the distribution of clustering results for the FineWeb-Edu Classifier
errors.evidence: The figure contains TWO pie charts: one for AttentionInfluence (left) and one for FineWeb-Edu Classifier (right). The description only mentions the FineWeb-Edu Classifier, ignoring the AttentionInfluence chart entirely.
The description completely omits the AttentionInfluence chart, which is one of the two main charts in the figure.

Each chart has a two-ring structure: 6 inner slices (main categories) and 15 outer slices (sub-categories) for AttentionInfluence, and similar structure for FineWeb-Edu Classifier. The description incorrectly counts 28 slices and ignores the dual-ring (inner/outer) structure.
The description fails to mention the nested/two-ring structure of the pie charts (inner ring showing main categories and outer ring showing sub-categories), which is a key visual feature.

errors.text_span: the largest slice being "Science & technology education" at approximately 19%, followed by "Education" at 17%, and "Healthy education" at 15%
errors.evidence: In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier, 'Education' is the largest category at 38% (inner ring). 'Teaching & resources' is 17% and 'Science & technology education' is 19% (outer ring). 'Healthy education' is 2%, not 15%.

errors.text_span: "Historical review" is represented by a prominent, exploded slice, colored in orange, and "Events & people" is visually emphasized, appearing offset from the other slices
errors.evidence: Neither the image nor the reference description indicates any exploded or offset slices. The charts show standard pie/donut charts without any emphasized or offset slices.

errors.text_span: The slices are colored in shades of blue, orange, and green
errors.evidence: The charts use multiple colors including blue, orange, green, red/pink, and brown. The description undersells the color variety.

The description does not mention that the numbers on the slices represent counts/percentages, nor does it mention all inner main categories (Fin & Law, Tech & Engineering, History & Society, Science, Health & Medicine for AttentionInfluence chart).
The description does not mention that there is no separate legend, and that all slice labels are placed directly on or near the slices.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their angular size.
errors.evidence: The slices are not clearly ordered from largest to smallest; they appear to be grouped by category (color), not sorted by size.
